blocks.text: For the first time ever, Gong Yoo, the “OG Oppa,” made his Manila debut, giving Filipino fans the fan meeting they had long been waiting for. The renowned South Korean actor took the stage for ‘The Long Take Asia Fanmeeting Tour’ before a packed Smart Araneta Coliseum crowd on November 21. The Big Dome was transformed into a cozy living room, a setting that matched the warm, laid-back charm of the actor himself. What made the night even more special was Anne Curtis’ role as host.
